configurationDefinition.allOtherInputs: Exactly the 115-control matrix-window-final configuration, A-H on; no optimization or filter changes.
configurationDefinition.strategyProperties: 10000 USD, 0.01 percent commission per side, 2 ticks slippage, pyramiding 0, 1x long/short leverage, bar-close calculation, one-tick order delay. Explicit Pine qty controls size.

evaluationRules: M5 is the pre-existing primary research interval; do not select an interval after seeing this holdout.
Obtain an exact editor copy-back and complete actual input/Properties captures for this future run. This file does not assert those future runtime settings.
Record available history/warm-up and require at least 1000 preceding M5 bars before the holdout start; report failure if the account cannot supply the required context.
Include every admitted plan and every position entered inside the window. Preserve unmatched/open positions separately; follow cross-end positions to closure without admitting new plans.
Aggregate partial exit rows by actual entry identity; report complete position counts, costs, net profit, profit factor, intratrade and closed-position drawdowns separately.
Report actual counts and all losses; fewer than 30 complete positions makes this small study inconclusive, and 30 is not a statistical-power guarantee.
Use Nov 6-13 and Nov 13-20 only as predeclared chronological summaries; do not retune between them or label them walk-forward optimization.
No parameter/source/window selection after viewing holdout outcomes. A change creates a separate disclosed experiment and cannot retain this protocol identity.
Keep all raw Pine Logs and available native report evidence, including negative or incomplete outcomes.
Optional manual closed-bar observation and reload captures on Free can document specific signal stability; they do not become Bar Replay evidence.
limitations: Locally timestamped preparation, not independent preregistration.
No future market results exist in this artifact.
Does not close Replay, baseline parity, OOS, walk-forward or profitability gates.
